label_treatment.why: Disgust is negative but has no dependable arousal direction, so its quadrant is a choice rather than a reading. Excluded here rather than asserting a placement we cannot justify.

axes.interpretation: Arousal is recovered well; valence is at or near chance. Since DSI weights valence at 0.45, close to half the index rests on the dimension the model does not resolve - which is the single most important limitation of the affect scale.

verdict: Accuracy 49.5% vs a majority-class baseline of 41.3% - the mapping carries real signal.
caveat: CREMA-D is acted, studio-quality American English. This validates the prosody model and our arousal/valence quadrant logic; it does not demonstrate in-domain performance on compressed F1 team radio. The implication runs one way only: a model that cannot recover emotion from clean acted speech is certainly not doing so on radio.
